mechanism.claim: A fixed-threshold directional change starts a new intrinsic-time overshoot regime. When a reversal is confirmed within the final hour of a completed high-variation eight-hour BTC block, follow the newly confirmed intrinsic direction for the next eight hours.
mechanism.side: long after the latest confirmed upward directional change; short after the latest confirmed downward directional change
mechanism.why_distinct: Prior directional-change scarcity work counted reversals and combined count tails with total displacement; intrinsic-topology work fed multi-threshold densities into a fitted classifier. HVDCOS uses neither count scarcity nor fitted topology: it uses one strictly prior volatility-scaled threshold, the state-machine direction of the latest confirmation, and confirmation recency. It reuses no prior event set or control and uses no volume, flow, OI, funding, or outcome fitting.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the completed current eight-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse intrinsic-time confirmations occurring in the final physical hour at 00/08/16 UTC boundaries are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.prior_scale_window: 288 exact nonoverlapping five-minute closes over [T-32h,T-8h), yielding 287 close-to-close log returns
features.directional_change_threshold: sqrt(sum squared prior-scale returns / 24), a fixed one-hour realized standard-deviation scale, finite strict positive and frozen for the entire current block
features.state_machine: initialize from the first close; establish initial up/down mode after a threshold move from the running opposite extreme; thereafter confirm down when peak-current>=threshold and confirm up when current-trough>=threshold, resetting the active extreme at confirmation
features.event: at least one post-initialization directional change is confirmed; the latest confirmation close is in [T-1h,T)
features.side: latest confirmed intrinsic direction, strict +1 or -1
features.current_variation: sqrt(sum squared 95 current-path close-to-close returns), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: published fixed-threshold directional-change overshoot state representation under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no threshold scale, current window, confirmation recency, variation rank, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: Golub, Chliamovitch, Dupuis and Chopard, Multi-scale Representation of High Frequency Market Liquidity
external_basis.support: directional changes and subsequent overshoots provide an event-based intrinsic-time state representation
external_basis.selection_use: canonical fixed-threshold directional-change/overshoot state machine only; BTC threshold scaling, recency, direction and hold application are untested; no incidence or outcomes
